method.scope: Only analysis paragraphs of the eight use cases and cross-cutting section between ANALYSIS markers; titles, product lists, introduction, and references excluded.
method.explicit: Case-insensitive whole-word alias occurrences. Longest overlapping match wins; each occurrence is counted once.
method.implicit: Conservative, analyst-selected descriptive phrases. One mention per term per sentence, only if the sentence has no explicit alias for that term. Phrase rules and full evidence are provided. This is an operational estimate, not an exhaustive semantic frequency.
method.edges: A term-to-section link means at least one explicit or implicit mention. Solid green = explicit; dashed orange = implicit. Width is fixed; counts are shown in nodes and evidence.
method.zero: Zero means no match under these rules, not proof that the concept is absent.

sections.title: 3. Internal knowledge search and research assistance
